build_binary_dilation: build a python module that performs binary dilation on a PyTorch tensor image using a structuring kernel
build_binary_erosion: build a python module that performs binary erosion on a PyTorch tensor image using a structuring kernel
build_binary_denoising: build a python module that denoises a binary image tensor using combined opening and closing morphological operations
run_get_edges: run Sobel edge detection on a PyTorch tensor mask and return a binary edge tensor
run_expand_mask: run binary dilation on a PyTorch tensor mask using a disk-shaped structuring element with a given radius
